# Fixture attribution

The real replay fixtures (`aaaaa.osr`, `domino.osr`, `deafheaven.osr`) are the
author's own plays, with the player name anonymized to `TestPlayer`.

The beatmap (`.osu`) fixtures are included as small extracts for testing and
are credited to their mappers:

| File | Song | Difficulty | Mapper |
|---|---|---|---|
| `aaaaa.osu` | Nashimoto Ui feat. Hatsune Miku - AaAaAaAAaAaAAa | Hard Easy xD | XxX[xXx]XxX |
| `domino.osu` | Jessie J - Domino (Nightcore & Cut Ver.) | Desire | Kumocha |
| `deafheaven.osu` | inoqx - DEAFHEAVEN | EXTREME COLLAB | namriee |

Synthetic fixtures (`synth_*.osu` / `synth_*.osr`) are generated by
`scripts/make_synthetic_fixtures.py` and contain no third-party content.
Regenerate with:

```sh
python scripts/make_synthetic_fixtures.py            # (re)generate synth_*
python scripts/make_synthetic_fixtures.py --anonymize  # rename player in real .osr fixtures
```
